# netactuate_router_vrf_bgp (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages the BGP configuration of a cloud router VRF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_vrf_bgp" "example" {
  local_asn = 64512
  networks {
    subnet = "192.0.2.0/24"
  }
  router_id = 12345
  vrf_id    = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `local_asn` (String) Your local ASN for BGP. Must be between 1 and 4294967294.
- `networks` (Block List, Min: 1) The list of networks to announce over your BGP sessions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--networks))
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the VRF.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Required:

- `subnet` (String) The network to announce via BGP.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_vrf_bgp.example 12345
```
